title: A path under an exclude_dirs entry is not source for the verification_ignored_paths overlap rule
description: a path under an exclude_dirs entry is not source for the verification_ignored_paths overlap rule
acceptance_criteria: (1) With code at the root (source_dirs = ["."]) and exclude_dirs = [".chough"], verification_ignored_paths entries .chough/sessions/, .chough/archive/ and .chough/bugs/ are accepted, and verification ignores those folders. (2) An entry whose excluded component differs from the exclude_dirs name in case, or whose excluded name lies above the source_dirs root it is under, is still refused for overlapping source_dirs. (3) Every other overlap rule still refuses, even for an entry under an excluded name: .specsync/, the specs tree, schema_dir, meaningful_paths, spec files:, depends_on, Consumed By, the policy files, the principles file and the templates.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-115: every other protected scope still refuses an entry; the coverage source walk compares exclude_dirs names exactly (coverage_name_is_excluded) and only below a source_dirs root
